name: reduction_fusion_vs_nonfused
description: Re-run of the reduction_fusion_with_scope_markers feature arm (alias-scope /noalias metadata commit 9d1a36186 on top of the fuse_reduction tip 5a5637c93), but paired against the NON-FUSED control (fuse_reduction_curated_base = 56139e4cd: IndexedElemwise read/write fusion present, no reduction fusion, no markers) as its declared base, so both arms run on the SAME runner. The original reduction_fusion_with_scope_markers experiment declared the no-markers tip as its base, so the dashboard's "markers / non-fused" ratio combined arms measured on different runners — a noise source for the tiny (~10-40 us) models. This experiment makes the comparison apples-to-apples to test whether the dashboard's red bars (fusion+markers slower than non-fused) replicate, or were cross-runner / small-model measurement noise. Local A/B (single core) showed C/A within +-7% on the small models, contradicting the dashboard's 1.1-1.4x.
